rationale: The full DS.AI scope explicitly excludes an AI-based system whose risk directly contributes to fatalities or multiple life-threatening injuries and certain online-learning systems. The conclusion that it cannot be presented as the complete path for this deliberately demanding hypothetical case is a bounded project inference; it does not claim that every DAA function necessarily falls in the exclusion.
limitations: A function-level failure-condition allocation is still required before classifying a concrete DAA function under the exclusion.
